proofs.text: Read `tools/QA/purlin-qa-report.md`; collect the bolded backticked answer names in the section that lists them and verify the collected list is exactly `sign`, `add a case`, `hold`, `skip`, in that order. Adding a fifth answer `looks fine` fails on the comparison, printing both lists
